cover.title: More customers,
cover.titleGradient: with a solution built for your business
cover.description: We are a partner focused on your success. First we analyze what your business needs. Then we implement the solution that brings you new customers.

approach.title: A partner focused on your success
approach.subtitle: A website, a few reviews or a Google profile do not bring customers on their own. A solution built for your business does, and we stay with you while it works.

oldWay.title: Buying separate services
items: A package designed for someone else's business
A price decided before anyone looked at yours

newWay.title: Working with a partner
items: One team accountable for your customer acquisition
A solution built from what your business needs
Services included only where they add value
Results measured together, in plain language

steps.title: Needs analysis
steps.description: The first call is free and it is the analysis: how you win customers today, where you lose them and what you need.

steps.title: A tailored solution
steps.description: We propose one solution built from the services you need, and quote it. A service may come included at no extra cost.

steps.title: We put it to work
steps.description: We implement the solution while you keep your focus on serving your customers well.

steps.title: We measure and adjust
steps.description: We review the results with you in plain language and adjust the solution to what changed.

localSeo.name: Local SEO
localSeo.title: Found first on Google, recommended by AI
localSeo.description: The work that makes your business visible in local Google searches and in the answers AI engines give. When Local SEO is part of your solution, it comes with all three pillars.

pillars.title: Authority content
pillars.description: The content that establishes your business as a reference in its field.

pillars.title: Authority on Google and AI
pillars.description: Your business and your website as the reference that gets recommended.
items: On page local SEO for your website
Presence in Google and AI results

pillars.title: Review management
pillars.description: Your reputation, measured and worked on month after month.

localSeo.goal: The first position on Google for searches in your area. No provider can guarantee a specific ranking and we do not promise one: we commit to the work that leads there.

blocks.title: Four more building blocks
blocks.description: Each one joins your solution when your business needs it, and it may come included at no extra cost.

items.name: Website Development
items.description: Fast websites and PWAs, designed to turn visitors into customers.
features: Performance anyone can check in PageSpeed Insights
Structured data, translations and llms.txt for Google and AI
Installable as an app on phones and computers

items.name: AI Voice Receptionist
items.description: A voice agent that answers your calls, handles frequent questions and books appointments, 24/7.
features: Appointments booked straight into your calendar
Custom voice and script matched to your brand

items.name: AI Business Automation
items.description: AI agents connected to the tools you already use, that follow up your customers and take repetitive work off your hands.
features: Every enquiry answered at once and followed up until it books or says no
Bookings, reminders, quotes and invoices, with you approving what matters
A review request after every visit, to every customer

items.name: Software and Mobile App Development
items.description: Full stack products with a Flutter frontend and a custom backend, for every device and screen.
features: One codebase for iOS, Android, web and desktop
Automated tests and a CI/CD pipeline
Full source code ownership on delivery

blocks.footnote: Every solution is quoted after the free needs analysis. Quotes exclude VAT.

process.title: What we look at in your first call
process.subtitle: Every business loses customers in its own way. These are the gaps we check first, because they decide which building blocks your solution needs.

problems.title: A website that does not convert
problems.description: A slow website, or one that leaves the visitor's questions unanswered, loses the customer right before they get in touch.

problems.title: Invisible on Google and AI
problems.description: If your business does not show up when someone searches for your service nearby, or asks an AI assistant, a competitor takes that customer.

problems.title: Calls nobody answers
problems.description: A call that goes unanswered after hours or at a busy moment is a customer who may call someone else.

terms.title: Quoted after the analysis
terms.description: We publish no price list beyond the entry price. Every solution is quoted after the free needs analysis, according to what your business needs.

terms.title: The entry price, then a monthly fee
terms.description: You start with a first implementation for {entryPrice} + VAT that commits both sides and takes the first steps. After that, a monthly fee tied to the results we bring you, agreed in the proposal. The new customers the solution brings in are what cover it.

terms.title: Quotes exclude VAT
terms.description: VAT is added on the invoice where it applies, at the rate that applies to your business.

terms.title: A goal, not a guarantee
terms.description: We work toward the first position. Results also depend on your market and your competition.

contact.title: Let's talk about your business
contact.description: The first call is free, and it is where the needs analysis starts: where your business stands today and what it needs.
contact.bookingDescription: Pick the day and time that suit you best. Scan the code or use the button.
contact.closing: You focus on serving your customers well. We take care of bringing them in.
